gizmo.title: Iqela lamanqaku okuyeka
gizmo.description: Pakisha amanqaku okuyeka amaninzi kwibhloko enye ebonisa inqaku elinye ngexesha, njenge-Iingcebiso okanye Yintoni entsha. Amakhadi emiyalelo, amanqaku asecaleni nezicatshulwa ezinesakhelo zingapakishwa nazo.
